EVERY STORE AND AIRPORT TRUSTS AI CAMERAS TO TRACK EVERY PERSON IN THE ROOM
slides.body:
That's the whole point of it.

Every person gets a box. Every second. No exceptions.

Until a shirt changed that

slides.headline: SIMON WECKERT KEPT TESTING PATTERNS UNTIL THE MACHINE STOPPED SEEING HIM
slides.body: He targeted YOLO, the AI that spots people in surveillance footage. The kind scanning the lobby you walked through this morning. He tested patterns until it stopped seeing him. Everyone else's box stayed
And nobody in the room noticed.

slides.headline: THE SHIRT THAT HIDES YOU FROM AI IS THE LOUDEST THING IN THE ROOM
slides.body:
A Hawaiian print. The kind you'd clock from across a room.

Every human saw it instantly. But to the machine watching the feed, he didn't exist

slides.headline: IT FOOLS CERTAIN AI SYSTEMS. NOT THE COPS.
slides.body: It works on open models like YOLO, used in real venues right now. A cop looking at the same screen would still see you. But every venue running this right now is already exposed.

slides.headline: EVERY BUSINESS RUNNING AI SECURITY NOW HAS A DOCUMENTED BLIND SPOT
slides.body:
Your automated security just became a fashion problem.

Any open system can be fooled with a shirt ordered online. No alarm triggered.

The fix is a software update

caption:
Swipe to see how a $75 Hawaiian shirt beat AI surveillance cameras while every person nearby got detected. 👁️

The belief that AI cameras reliably track every person, Simon Weckert and his YOLO test, the shirt that costs $75, the moment the AI drew boxes around the whole crowd and left a blank space where he stood, the irony that the loudest shirt in the room vanishes to the machine, the limits of the trick, and what it means for businesses running automated security.

AI surveillance is supposed to catch everyone, every time. One shirt just showed that's not always true. The camera in your store might have a blind spot anyone can order online.

Running a business with security systems? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this means for yours.
